title: Detailed Christmas tree
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Star on top -->
  <polygon points="50,6 53,14 61,14 55,19 57,27 50,22 43,27 45,19 39,14 47,14" fill="#FFD700" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  <!-- Glow around star -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="16" r="8" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.15"/>
  
  <!-- Tree trunk -->
  <rect x="46" y="88" width="8" height="10" rx="1" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <rect x="46" y="88" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#A0522D"/>
  
  <!-- Tree layers - bottom to top, each layer a triangle -->
  <!-- Bottom layer -->
  <polygon points="50,85 12,88 88,88" fill="#1B7A1B"/>
  <polygon points="50,85 12,88 88,88" fill="#228B22" opacity="0.5"/>
  <polygon points="50,72 18,88 82,88" fill="#228B22"/>
  <polygon points="50,72 30,88 50,88" fill="#2E8B2E" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- Second layer from bottom -->
  <polygon points="50,72 20,78 80,78" fill="#1B7A1B"/>
  <polygon points="50,58 24,78 76,78" fill="#228B22"/>
  <polygon points="50,58 35,78 50,78" fill="#2E8B2E" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- Middle layer -->
  <polygon points="50,58 26,66 74,66" fill="#1B7A1B"/>
  <polygon points="50,44 30,66 70,66" fill="#228B22"/>
  <polygon points="50,44 40,66 50,66" fill="#2E8B2E" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- Second layer from top -->
  <polygon points="50,44 32,52 68,52" fill="#1B7A1B"/>
  <polygon points="50,32 35,52 65,52" fill="#228B22"/>
  <polygon points="50,32 43,52 50,52" fill="#2E8B2E" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- Top layer -->
  <polygon points="50,32 38,40 62,40" fill="#1B7A1B"/>
  <polygon points="50,22 40,40 60,40" fill="#228B22"/>
  <polygon points="50,22 46,40 50,40" fill="#2E8B2E" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- Ornaments - red baubles -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="82" r="3" fill="#FF2020"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="82" r="1.5" fill="#FF6060"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="82" r="3" fill="#FF2020"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="82" r="1.5" fill="#FF6060"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="76" r="3" fill="#FF2020"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="76" r="1.5" fill="#FF6060"/>
  
  <!-- Ornaments - gold baubles -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="72" r="2.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="72" r="1.2" fill="#FFF080"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="72" r="2.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="72" r="1.2" fill="#FFF080"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="2.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="1.2" fill="#FFF080"/>
  
  <!-- Ornaments - blue baubles -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#4169E1"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="52" r="1.2" fill="#80A0FF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#4169E1"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="52" r="1.2" fill="#80A0FF"/>
  
  <!-- Ornaments - purple baubles -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="40" r="2" fill="#9B30FF"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="40" r="1" fill="#C080FF"/>
  
  <!-- Tinsel / garland lines -->
  <path d="M22,85 Q36,80 50,85 Q64,90 78,85" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M28,74 Q39,70 50,74 Q61,78 72,74" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M34,62 Q42,58 50,62 Q58,66 66,62" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M38,50 Q44,47 50,50 Q56,53 62,50" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Small lights on tree -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="84" r="1" fill="#FF4040"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="86" r="1" fill="#40FF40"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="78" r="1" fill="#4040FF"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="68" r="1" fill="#FFFF40"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="48" r="1" fill="#FF40FF"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="56" r="1" fill="#40FFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Small snow dots -->
  <circle cx="15" cy="30" r="1" fill="#E0E0FF"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="20" r="1" fill="#E0E0FF"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="35" r="1" fill="#E0E0FF"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="50" r="1" fill="#E0E0FF"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="55" r="1" fill="#E0E0FF"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="70" r="1" fill="#E0E0FF"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="75" r="1" fill="#E0E0FF"/>
</svg>
